about: Recovery seed and recovery file (L19, L20). aid is the KEL-2B agent; rs = SHA-256 of rs_label. next_keys: seed = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = rs, salt = "anet-kel-next/v1", info = UTF-8(aid) || 0x00 || u64be(seq), L = 32), pub its Ed25519 public key, next_digest = SHA-256(pub). passphrase_file: salt is the first 16 and nonce the first 24 bytes of SHA-256 of their labels; key = argon2id(NFC(passphrase), salt, t = 3, m = 65536 KiB, p = 4, 32); aad = coredet(RecoveryBlob without key 7); blob = coredet(RecoveryBlob) with ct = XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce, rs, aad); text is the file as written, before the caller's note lines. local_file: the same seed under kdf {1: "local"}, key = local_key = SHA-256 of its label. Each negative is a file opened with the interface and secret given, and the error class it must give; each derive negative is refused by next-key derivation.
